The name looks like a host-side deployment label (possibly Kimi K3 from Hugging Face weights in FP8, served by Nous) rather than a Nous model; if that reading is confirmed by whoever recorded the id, the underlying model's date would be moonshotai/kimi-k3, 2026-07-16. Not asserted here.
not_found.qwen/qwen-vl-plus: Ambiguous rather than unfindable. OpenRouter created the id on 2025-02-05 (per-model endpoint; delisted). But qwen-vl-plus is a moving alias on Alibaba Model Studio: the name dates from the original Qwen-VL-Plus (late 2023/early 2024), and during 2025 it pointed in turn at snapshots 2025-01-25, 2025-05-07 and 2025-08-15 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/en/notice/model_studio_update_of_qwen_vlplus_4df). Which model wrote a given text depends on when it was called; the candidates fall in different half-years, so no single date is given.

nousresearch/hermes-4-405b.note: The ledger's 2005-08-06 is almost certainly a typo of 2025-08-06, which is the creation date of the Hugging Face repo NousResearch/Hermes-4-405B (then not yet public). Nous announced and released Hermes 4 on 2025-08-26; OpenRouter listed it the same day. Both dates are in H2 2025.
